--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The native libraries inside the published AAR
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The AAR redistributes compiled copies of the projects below, built from
unmodified release sources at the tags named in buildscripts/include/depinfo.sh.
They are NOT covered by libmpvKt's Apache-2.0 licence. Because mpv is GPL and
FFmpeg is configured with --enable-gpl --enable-version3, the AAR as a whole can
only be redistributed under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.
An application that ships it is bound by that licence.

  mpv           GPL-2.0-or-later      https://mpv.io
  FFmpeg        GPL-3.0-or-later      https://ffmpeg.org  (as configured; LGPL by default)
  libass        ISC                   https://github.com/libass/libass
  libplacebo    LGPL-2.1-or-later     https://code.videolan.org/videolan/libplacebo
  dav1d         BSD-2-Clause          https://code.videolan.org/videolan/dav1d
  Mbed TLS      Apache-2.0            https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls
  HarfBuzz      MIT                   https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz
  FreeType      FTL                   https://freetype.org
  FriBidi       LGPL-2.1-or-later     https://github.com/fribidi/fribidi
  libunibreak   zlib                  https://github.com/adah1972/libunibreak
  Lua           MIT                   https://www.lua.org
  libc++        Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception, from the Android NDK

The complete corresponding source of mpv and FFmpeg is attached to every
libmpvKt GitHub release beside the binaries, and every other project is
reachable at the tag named in BUILD-INFO.txt inside each release zip.
